seed: Pulling a label's right edge in to re-wrap it. The handle is on the box a person can see, so it sits on the last letter, and what the drag hands back gains the room the renderer draws the words in again. Lining a label up with its neighbours is the same change one layer down (Snapping offers a label's words as the magnet); that one is covered by tests rather than by a picture, because a short label's box stops at eighty points wide and the last letter is nowhere near its edge.

steps.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

steps.note: one long line, hugging its words. W is how wide the words are.
THE TEST: the right edge was grabbed where the box is DRAWN. The words re-wrapped to the new width and the blue box is still flush to them, top, bottom and both sides.
